description: Oregon motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: An adult passenger on a motorcycle in Oregon
questions.explanation: The Oregon helmet law covers passengers as well as the operator.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Oregon?
questions.explanation: Oregon helmet law: all riders and passengers.

questions.q: What does Oregon require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: Oregon: eye protection is not required by state law.

provenance.manual: Oregon Motorcycle & Moped Manual - Section Three

questions.q: In Oregon, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: Oregon issues a motorcycle permit at 16 years at the earliest.
